meta.title: Free creator marketing playbooks and AI frameworks | Tano
meta.description: Free playbooks for brands running creator programmes: finding the creators who drive revenue, seeding and affiliate, and rebriefing creators for paid ads.

hero.title: Frameworks for creator-led growth.
paragraphs: Free AI frameworks and workflows for influencer marketing teams. Drawn from running 500+ campaigns across consumer brands.

items.title: Content Analysis Framework
items.body: Use Claude Skills and Gemini to analyse your best-performing influencer content in under an hour. Includes skill files, prompt templates, and a full how-to guide.

items.title: The Creator Discovery Guide
items.body: Find the 3–5 creators who drive 80% of revenue. A data-backed guide to creator selection, tiering, and management — based on 10,000+ creator seedings.

items.title: Creator Partnership Ads Playbook
items.body: The complete guide to running creator-led ads on Meta. Covering creator selection, briefing, pricing, performance reporting, and timelines — with a Bloom & Wild case study.

items.title: The Seeding → Affiliate Playbook
items.body: How to build a creator programme that pays for itself — from gifting to affiliates to whitelisted ads. Includes the break-even formula, posting rate benchmarks, and the seeding → affiliate → whitelist pyramid.

items.title: The Rebriefing Playbook
items.body: How to turn your best organic creators into a high-converting paid ads engine — without cold outreach, guesswork, or wasted spend. Covers warm rebriefing, the seeding-to-paid flow, product type considerations, and scaling the programme.

closing.title: Let's scale your creator programme.
closing.body: The playbooks are a head start. Want us to run it? 30-minute intro, no slides — we'll tell you whether Tano fits.
